title: Are internal borders of importing/ destination Partner States still handling cargo clearance? - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Are internal borders of importing/ destination Partner States still handling cargo clearance?
Yes but with reduced controls at the internal border stations. Such borders include Malaba, Busia, Mutukula, Katuna, Cyanika, Lwakhakha etc.
